mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans (parent_id, title, description, status, start_date, due_date, sort_order, created_at, user_id) VALUES (#{parent_id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{start_date}, #{due_date}, #{sort_order}, #{created_at}, #{user_id});
mapper.update: UPDATE plans SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, start_date = #{start_date}, due_date = #{due_date} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id};
